nodes.title: T7 Docs hygiene sweep: B-11 paperwork, testing.md counts, Constraints convention, main.py ASCII
Repair B-11 AC-1 - the admin-slot set-difference has been red on main since B-10 merged
T9 Staff PIN integrity: hash on bootstrap, no plaintext env fallback, constant-time compare, rotation revokes tokens
T10 JWT secret strength gate: reject published/example secrets and short values at startup
T11 Guest capability redesign: server-minted unguessable status token, no PII in URLs
T12 Frontend dependency advisories: dev-server RCE-class and react-router open redirect to fixed versions
FINAL regression gate: every closed-feature QA surface re-passes green after the audit batch
T14 Waitlist board render scale: bound the lists or virtualise, replace 3s full-list refetch
T15 Mock data out of the shipped bundle: env-gated dynamic import, build-time CI assertion, seed PIN not a literal
Contract completion: client-facing 404 trio, bodiless 422 docs, Close-Day endpoint
Frontend client lifecycle: expires_at honoured, router-driven redirect, shared-UI resource cleanup
Response-envelope compliance: contract error envelope on every non-2xx, including router-level refusals
Store contention is a contract outcome: busy/locked maps to a retryable code, WAL or documented single-writer, no silent 500
T20 ENV fail-open: ENV must be explicit; development-mode reset and SQL echo must not be reachable by default
T21 Log hygiene: no PII or tracebacks to stdout, no credentials in query strings, specs 593-598 honoured
eslint flat config for eslint 9: author it, get the codebase lint-clean, retire the D-03 AC-6 inversion
T23 Rate limiter actually applies to API routes, honours proxy trust, covers change-pin, and states its memory bound
SQLite-only reality vs PostgreSQL affordance: add the driver and exercise the path, or remove the claim
Repository artifact hygiene: gitignore DB sidecars and local dot-env files; no DB artifacts left in the tree
Security headers on every response class plus CSP, HSTS-ready, cache policy
CI from nothing: lint+test+audit workflows on push, frontend build smoke, secret-scan on PRs
ready.py readiness tool: closed-set by issue-map intersect platform-state, never by title parse
Integer and length bounds live in schemas: no overflow-500, no out-of-domain values persisted
T30 Frontend session storage: one store, one key, remember-me actually controls persistence, real logout
Staff waitlist list paginates in SQL instead of materialising the full result
T32 Frontend speaks the published contract: real API integration works with VITE_USE_MOCK=false
T33 Run surface actually runs: make seed/dev/test-backend resolve an interpreter on this machine
T34 Integration acceptance gate: a seeded store plus both servers complete the documented demo unattended
T35 test-infra: drvfs SQLite flake between test_log_hygiene and test_db_atomicity (disk I/O error in setup)
T36 test-infra: test_rate_limit_t23.py XFF tests order-dependent shared limiter state (flake)
